verdict.rationale: All options nominally fit the stated meeting times and use an allowed one-stop economy itinerary, but none is clearly dominant on the supplied facts. B is cheaper and has earlier arrival/return timing but shorter connections. A and C cost more but offer somewhat longer connection buffers. D is least expensive but uses MDW and leaves a much smaller pre-meeting arrival buffer while returning substantially later. The query provides no required airport, ground-transfer/meeting buffer, tolerance for connection risk, or priority between cost and schedule.
